metadata.title: Cloudphone Agent WebRTC Core Differential Result
metadata.evaluation_methodology: Strict non-tautological protocol evaluation with discrete parity classifications

exact_protocol_parity_cases.description: Agent WebSocket registration to /register_agent yielding agent_register_ok (status=valid)
Agent periodic heartbeat frame emission maintaining active connection within 60s read deadline
SDP offer contains confirmed video/H264 (90000) and audio/opus (48000/2ch/minptime=10) with unconfirmed codecs excluded
Local media tracks constructed with exact IDs display_0 and audio_0 via NewTrackLocalStaticSample
Three outbound DataChannels (input-channel, clipboard-channel, camera-channel) created with ordered=true before offer
Three inbound DataChannels (file-channel, ai-command-channel, adb-channel) recognized in OnDataChannel listener
Signaling relay forward of request-offer initiates PeerSession and offer generation
Agent SDP offer wrapped in forward envelope and delivered to client as device_msg
Client SDP answer routed to agent matching client_id and applied via SetRemoteDescription
Trickle ICE candidate payloads exchanged bidirectionally between agent and client via signaling
Agent receives client_disconnected notice and idempotently tears down associated PeerSession
WebRTC P2P ICE connectivity succeeds and transitions PeerConnectionState to Connected

semantic_parity_cases.description: Synthetic Annex-B H.264 sample written via WriteSample delivered as RTP packet to receiving client
Synthetic Opus sample written via WriteSample delivered as RTP packet to receiving client

implementation_choice_cases.description: Internal SessionState enums and transitions (Connecting -> HaveLocalOffer -> Connected -> Closed)
sync.Once guarding Close() against duplicate concurrent teardowns
Coordinator map-based session isolation with RWMutex concurrency protection
ErrSessionClosed returned safely for operations submitted after session teardown
